units.source_text: 次日夕雾的慰问信，依旧像情书一般偷偷地送来。

en.t: The next day, Yugiri's letter of consolation was secretly delivered again, just like a love letter.

units.source_text: 云居雁今天反而比从前更加懒写回信了。

en.t: Today Kumoi no Kari was, if anything, even less inclined than before to write a reply.

units.source_text: 几个尖刻的侍女便互相交头接耳，挤眉弄眼。

en.t: Several sharp-tongued ladies-in-waiting began whispering among themselves and exchanging knowing looks.

units.source_text: 正在此时，内大臣进来了，云居雁局促不安。

en.t: Just then, the Minister of the Center came in, and Kumoi no Kari grew awkward and uneasy.

units.source_text: 夕雾的信中写道：“只因姐姐对我，永不开诚相待。

en.t: Yugiri's letter said, "It is only because your elder sister never treats me with an open heart.

units.source_text: 故虽已与君结缡，反觉我身不幸。

en.t: Thus, although I have already been joined with you in marriage, I feel instead that I am unfortunate.

units.source_text: 然而爱慕之情，永远不绝，故欲凭此书消我愁思。

en.t: Yet my feelings of love and longing will never cease, and so I hope to ease my sorrow through this letter.
